An IPTVX regression exposed Almagharibia rendering one frame and then stalling even though conventional decoders passed. The relay was repaired by selecting a fixed 720p H.264/AAC rendition, parsing YouTube's path-based signature expiry correctly, and replacing oversized signed segment URLs with short Apple-compatible relay paths while removing nonstandard ad-cue tags.

The repaired Almagharibia endpoint passed three strict moving-media gates, a continuous 45-second public decode, and 20 seconds each of visibly changing current video in IPTVX preview and full-player modes. It remains published and no verified channel was lost.

The GitHub cloud refresher now rotates the same four official YouTube player endpoints and sends their documented Android client identity, preventing one challenged player host from leaving the signed recovery wrapper stale.
